summary: Teen Engagement Features (XP, Daily Rewards, Friend Streaks) testing completed successfully. All 17 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI fully functional with EngagementStatus component displaying XP, Level, Coins, Login Streak, and XP Progress bar correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows 404 error when trying to refresh user data after quick log (AxiosError), but session is logged successfully and XP is awarded

action_items: Minor: Investigate 404 error on data refresh after quick log (non-blocking, session logging works)
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: GET /api/engagement/status correctly returns xp, level_info, coins, login_streak, session_streak, can_claim_daily
Backend: POST /api/engagement/daily-login awards coins (5-50 based on streak day) and XP (10), correctly shows already_claimed on duplicate
Backend: GET /api/engagement/xp-history returns transactions with amount, reason, timestamp, new_total
Backend: GET /api/engagement/leaderboard/xp returns users sorted by XP with rank, username, xp, level, title
Backend: GET /api/engagement/friend-streaks returns mutual activity streaks with friends
Backend: POST /api/sessions/complete awards XP (25 base + 15 first_session_of_day + streak bonus) and returns xp_earned, leveled_up, level_info
Backend: Level calculation works correctly - user leveled up from Level 1 to Level 2 at 100 XP
Frontend: EngagementStatus component (data-testid='engagement-status-section') displays Coins, Login Streak, Total XP
Frontend: XP Progress bar shows level, title, current XP, and progress to next level
Frontend: Claim Daily Reward button (data-testid='claim-daily-btn') hidden when already claimed today
Frontend: Quick Log modal works with pillar selection and minute options (15, 30, 45, 60)
Frontend: Toast notifications show for session logging and badge unlocks
seed_data_creation: Test player completed onboarding with 3 pillars (Fitness/Training, Study/Academics, Reading/Learning). Multiple sessions logged for XP testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Teen Engagement Features fully tested. Key endpoints: 1) GET /api/engagement/status - returns XP, level_info, coins, streaks, can_claim_daily, 2) POST /api/engagement/daily-login - awards coins (5-50 based on streak) and 10 XP, shows already_claimed if duplicate, 3) GET /api/engagement/xp-history - returns XP transactions, 4) GET /api/engagement/leaderboard/xp - returns users ranked by XP, 5) GET /api/engagement/friend-streaks - returns mutual streaks with friends, 6) POST /api/sessions/complete - awards XP (25 base + bonuses). Frontend: EngagementStatus component on Dashboard shows Coins, Login Streak, Total XP, Level badge, XP progress bar. Claim Daily Reward button visible only when can_claim_daily=true. Quick Log section allows fast session logging.
